cells.reason: No Jersey City ordinance on just-cause eviction appears in the documents. The city office only administers rent control (ch. 260). Good-cause eviction is governed at the state level by the NJ Anti-Eviction Act.
cells.quoted_span: A landlord must have good cause to evict a tenant (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-53).

cells.reason: No Jersey City ordinance on security deposits appears in the documents. The state Security Deposit Law governs.
cells.quoted_span: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).

cells.reason: No Jersey City ordinance on application fees appears in the documents. The state fee cap in P.L.2025, c.405 applies.
cells.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.

cells.reason: No Jersey City ordinance on tenant screening appears in the documents. The state Fair Chance in Housing Act and the Law Against Discrimination (source of income) govern.
cells.quoted_span: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
